The '''Iotran rifle-ax''' was an exotic weapon traditional to the [[Iotran Guard/Legends|Iotran Guard]] employed by the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. It consisted of a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] embedded in the handle. [[Iotran/Legends|Iotrans]] were well trained in both melee and ranged combat styles.
